title.ja: 居飛車 飛車と角が同じ方向に
title.en: Static Rook: rook and bishop face the same direction

explain.ja: 居飛車は、飛車を2筋(後手なら8筋)から動かさずに戦う戦法で、攻撃力が高いのが特徴です。飛車と角が同じ方向に利くので大駒でどんどん攻められます。一方で玉を囲うのが難しく、右に囲うと飛車が、左に囲うと角が邪魔になります。攻撃重視で守りが薄くなりがちなので、激しく戦いたい人に向きます。
explain.en: Static Rook keeps the rook on the 2nd file (the 8th for White) and fights from there; its strength is attacking power. The rook and bishop work in the same direction, so major pieces can attack aggressively. The drawback is that building a castle is hard: castling to the right gets in the rook's way, and castling to the left gets in the bishop's way. It is attack-oriented with thin defense, suiting players who want fierce fights.

title.ja: 振り飛車 飛車と角の方向がバラバラ
title.en: Ranging Rook: rook and bishop face different directions

explain.ja: 振り飛車は、飛車を一度左側に動かしてから戦う戦法です。飛車と角が別々の方向を向くので、攻めるのには向きませんが、飛車も角もいない右側に玉を囲うので守りをがっちり固められます。振り飛車ではしっかり守ってから戦えます。居飛車・振り飛車のどちらでも、角交換をするかどうかで戦い方が大きく変わります。
explain.en: Ranging Rook moves the rook to the left side before fighting. The rook and bishop point in different directions, so it is less suited to aggressive attacks, but the king castles on the right side where neither rook nor bishop sits, giving a solid defense. You can defend firmly before fighting. Within both Static Rook and Ranging Rook, whether the bishops are exchanged greatly changes the play.
